unsupported: The company began as a manufacturer of whipped cream equipment and has remained in continuous operation for over seven decades.
The company designs and builds whipped cream dispensers and related equipment for commercial food service operations.
Its equipment is engineered to deliver consistent portion control and to accommodate a variety of cream types and flavorings.
Gruenewald serves the food service industry, supplying restaurants, cafes, bakeries, and other establishments that serve fresh whipped cream.
